title: Credit Limit Increase Decisions — FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit
content:
An increase request on a FlexLine Personal Lines of Credit line awaiting decision is decided once the borrower authorizes the hard credit inquiry in person; the decision is recorded on the request and the approved limit takes effect at once. The approved limit is never below the current credit limit and never 0.00; when it comes to the current credit limit the request is still recorded with that limit as the approved limit, and the line stays as it is.

## What an increase needs

An increase also needs no minimum payment on the line paid 30 or more days after its due date in the last 12 months (in place of the run of consecutive on-time minimum payments the tier's parameter describes) and fewer other increase requests in the last 6 months, besides the one being decided, than the tier's number of increase requests accepted per rolling 6 months, uses a hard credit inquiry the borrower authorizes, and is granted in the amount set under this policy, never above the limit requested or the tier's maximum limit; the tier itself never changes.

A window of the last N months takes the entries dated after the same day of the month N months before the decision date.

## When the approved limit is fixed

The approved limit is fixed only after every returned payment on the line whose return code carries a fee shows its returned-payment fee entry.

The approved limit is not fixed until each draw on the line carries a draw-fee entry, wherever the tier charges a draw fee.

The approved limit is fixed only after the returned-payment fee of a return that has a replacement payment recorded against it carries a courtesy fee-waiver entry.

## Decision tool: `authorize_limit_increase_21546d5b`

**What it does.** The borrower authorizes the hard inquiry in person; the increase request awaiting decision is recorded as approved on the current day with the approved limit, and the line's credit limit is set to the approved limit at once. The borrower sees the new credit limit and the recorded decision.

**How it is invoked.** This is the customer's own tool. The agent unlocks `authorize_limit_increase_21546d5b` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it, which is the in-person authorization of the hard inquiry.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_line_id` | reference number of the FlexLine, read from the FlexLine account lookup | identifier |
| `limit_request_id` | reference number of the increase request awaiting decision, read from the FlexLine limit-request lookup for that line | identifier |
| `approved_limit` | the credit limit approved | USD decimal with 2 decimal places (cents); no currency sign and no thousands separator |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with `limit_request_id` (the request decided), `previous_limit` (the credit limit before the decision, USD with 2 decimal places), `credit_limit` (the approved limit now in force, USD with 2 decimal places) and `decision_status` (approved). The `decision_status` confirms the request was decided.
